name: au-deductions-offsets
description: Use this skill to work out what an Australian taxpayer can claim: deductions, tax offsets, rebates, credits, capital allowances and small business concessions, and how they interact. It maps the general "credits, reliefs, deductions and allowances" category onto Australian concepts, which behave differently from each other. Trigger on phrases like "what can I claim", "tax deductions Australia", "work-related expenses", "$1,000 standard deduction", "instant tax deduction", "tax offset", "rebate", "low income tax offset", "LITO", "refundable offset", "franking credits refund", "substantiation", "do I need a receipt", "capital or revenue", "apportion private use", "small business concessions". It routes to the specialist guides rather than restating their rules.
